name: Revenant maledictus
overview: There is a small chance of the maledictus appearing whenever any revenant is slain in the Revenant Caves. This chance is calculated each kill with the total accumulated combat levels of revenants slain by all players on that world, divided by a flat spawn rate. Once the maledictus appears, this chance is reset and the boss is prevented from appearing for 45 minutes, after which the spawn chance begins accumulating once again.

While the maledictus is active, all players in the cavern will be notified of its presence and given a hint as to where it appeared: northern, middle, or southern areas of the caves. Players in range will also see a flashing arrow on their mini-map pointing to the boss's location, making an encounter with other players all but guaranteed. The maledictus will remain active for 10 minutes before disappearing, if not killed.

The maledictus can spawn in the following areas: *Revenant cyclops/Revenant demon chamber (north) *Revenant dragon's chamber (north) *Northern revenant imp's area (north) *Revenant hellhound's/old revenants' ruins (middle) *Eastern revenant pyrefiend's area (middle) *Western revenant pyrefiend's chamber (middle) *Revenant dark beast's chamber (middle) *Northern revenant ork's chamber (middle) *Southern revenant ork's chamber (south) *Southern revenant demon's chamber (south) *Outside the southern revenant demon's area (south)

Despite the caves being singles-plus combat, the maledictus itself is functionally multi-combat; it can be attacked by any number of players, and will attack all players in range simultaneously. The maledictus will cycle through its three special attacks after every few standard attacks, telegraphing each attack with the Zarosian symbol on its back. Protection prayers will reduce damage taken by half. Its attacks are as follows:

* Standard attack: a white, spike-shaped ranged attack. * Ice spell: When the symbol glows blue, it will target players' current tiles, then freeze anyone who doesn't move, dealing damage and preventing them from moving or attacking. * Blood spell: When the symbol glows red, it will target players' current tiles, then deal damage and heal itself for half of the total damage dealt. * Air surge: When the symbol glows white, it will launch a typeless area-of-effect at one player. The spell explodes outward from where it lands, and deals up to 25 damage to anyone in a 5x5 area, but less near the edges.

Upon death, the top-damaging player wearing an amulet of avarice will receive the Forinthry Surge skull, which provides an additional 15% accuracy and damage buff against all revenants for 30 minutes. The Forinthry Surge skull can also be acquired by killing another player who has it, as long as both players are wearing an avarice. Taking the amulet off will remove the buff, while changing worlds will reduce its duration by 1 minute. The equipped amulet can be checked to show the Surge's time remaining.
Upon death, the revenant maledictus will reward players appropriately for their efforts:

*The top damaging player will obtain either an ancient totem or ancient emblem drop, along with two rolls on the revenant dragon's drop table. They will additionally gain the Forinthry Surge buff, provided that they were wearing an amulet of avarice before it died. **Ironmen are eligible for both Forinthry Surge and item drops, as long as they are the top damage dealer. *All other players will get one blighted super restore and two pieces of blighted food drop under them regardless of their location as long as they dealt damage to the boss.
